symbols.name: number of axes
symbols.meaning: The number of axes of the array, which counts the coordinates each entry is indexed by.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, and index them by $\ell = 1,\dots,d$.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The position of an axis, running from 1 to d.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes, and index them by $\ell = 1,\dots,d$.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries along axis ℓ, a power of two.
symbols.quote: Let $r_\ell$, a power of two, be the number of entries along axis $\ell$.

symbols.name: input index
symbols.meaning: The input index along axis ℓ, running over 0 to r_ℓ − 1.
symbols.quote: For each axis, $j_\ell$ and $k_\ell$ are the input and output indices along it, both running over $0,\dots,r_\ell-1$.

symbols.name: output index
symbols.meaning: The output index along axis ℓ, running over 0 to r_ℓ − 1.
symbols.quote: For each axis, $j_\ell$ and $k_\ell$ are the input and output indices along it, both running over $0,\dots,r_\ell-1$.

symbols.name: input array
symbols.meaning: The array whose entries A_{j_1…j_d} are the input to the transform.
symbols.quote: Let $A$ be the input array, with entries $A_{j_1\cdots j_d}$, and $B$ the transformed array, with entries $B_{k_1\cdots k_d}$.

symbols.name: transformed array
symbols.meaning: The array whose entries B_{k_1…k_d} are the output of the transform.
symbols.quote: Let $A$ be the input array, with entries $A_{j_1\cdots j_d}$, and $B$ the transformed array, with entries $B_{k_1\cdots k_d}$.

relations.quote: The transform applies one [Discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) on each axis.
It is built with the [tensor product](tensor-product.md) of these one-axis maps, so each map acts only along its own axis.
